**STEP 8 - Sanity check:** A lightly dressed side salad covering about a quarter of a dinner plate should weigh tens of grams and carry roughly 20 to 60 kcal. The estimate of about 51 g and 21 kcal fits. The dressing amount is the most uncertain part, so the energy could be somewhat higher if more dressing was used.
